On The 4 th Of December, 2025

 Mahesh Mali
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Shri Parakram Singh Chouhan - Advocate for the appl  Shri Santosh Singh Thakur- GA appearing on behalf o  General[r-1].
 ORDER 1.

This is applicant's first application under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973) for grant of anticipatory bail, as he/she is apprehending his/her arrest in connection with Crime No.394/2025 registered at Police Station Y.D.Nagar District Mandsaur (MP) for offence punishable under Section 420, 467, 468, 471 of the IPC.

2. Allegation against the applicant is of his involvement in the present case of fraud wherein a registry was forged on the basis of impersonation, in which the applicant had signed as a witness,
whereas the seller/Rajendra Kumar Shukla, had already died in the year 28.3.2023, and the registry was executed on 14.6.2024.
3.

Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:37315 2 MCRC-47025-2025 falsely implicated in the case as he had only signed the agreement as a witness, and he is not the beneficiary.
Hence, it is submitted that the application be allowed and the applicant be released on anticipatory bail.
4. Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.
